# ============================================================
# Run On Console - security + static routing (Phase 0)
# Restored from .htaccess.bac WITHOUT the Passenger (Node) block.
# Blog/PHP routing is NOT switched on here - that comes in Phase 1.
# ============================================================
DirectoryIndex index.html index.php

<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
  RewriteEngine On
  RewriteBase /

  # Private / internal paths -> 403
  RewriteRule ^database\.sql$ - [F,L,NC]
  RewriteRule ^release-manifest\.json$ - [F,L,NC]
  RewriteRule ^migrations(/.*)?$ - [F,L,NC]
  RewriteRule ^STEP-B(/.*)?$ - [F,L,NC]
  RewriteRule ^api/v1/cron(/.*)?$ - [F,L,NC]
  RewriteRule ^api/v1/api(/.*)?$ - [F,L,NC]
  RewriteRule ^api/v1/vendor(/.*)?$ - [F,L,NC]
  RewriteRule ^api/v1/composer\.(json|lock)$ - [F,L,NC]
  RewriteRule ^api/v1/DEPLOYMENT-README\.txt$ - [F,L,NC]
  RewriteRule (^|/)error_log$ - [F,L,NC]
  RewriteRule (^|/)(php\.ini|\.user\.ini)$ - [F,L,NC]
  RewriteRule ^env\.example\.php$ - [F,L,NC]
  RewriteRule \.(sql|gz|zip|log|env|yml|yaml|sh|git|bac|bak|config)$ - [F,L,NC]

  # www -> non-www
  RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^www\.runonconsole\.com$ [NC]
  RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://runonconsole.com/$1 [R=301,L]

  # Force HTTPS
  RewriteCond %{HTTPS} off
  RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://%{HTTP_HOST}/$1 [R=301,L]

  # API passes straight through
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} ^/api/ [NC]
  RewriteRule ^ - [L]

  # Auth aliases
  RewriteRule ^login/?$ /auth/login/ [R=301,L]
  RewriteRule ^signup/?$ /auth/signup/ [R=301,L]
  RewriteRule ^register/?$ /auth/signup/ [R=301,L]

  # Real file or folder -> serve as-is
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -f [OR]
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -d
  RewriteRule ^ - [L]

  # Unknown route -> real 404
  RewriteRule ^ - [R=404,L]
</IfModule>

ErrorDocument 404 /404.html
ErrorDocument 403 /404.html

<IfModule mod_headers.c>
  <FilesMatch "^(robots\.txt|llms\.txt)$">
    Header set Content-Type "text/plain; charset=utf-8"
  </FilesMatch>
  <IfModule mod_setenvif.c>
    SetEnvIf Request_URI "^/(admin|auth|profile|api|cms)" PRIVATE_ROUTE
    Header set X-Robots-Tag "noindex, nofollow" env=PRIVATE_ROUTE
  </IfModule>
  Header set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
  Header set X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN"
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_deflate.c>
  AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE text/html text/plain text/xml text/css text/javascript application/javascript application/json
</IfModule>
